C cl.vocab-must EX - DEFINITION ;; Interpret 'must / must not' so that any violation is a defect. ;; = ;; none ;; Interpretive meta-rule; the oracle defines no modal vocabulary. It fixes the binding force of every candidate 'must' (no 'must' is softened to guidance).
C cl.vocab-default EX - MUST ;; Any deviation from a rule marked 'default' needs a concrete reason and must be reported. ;; = ;; none ;; The oracle's DEFAULT policies allow deviation with justification but do not require deviations to be reported; this adds a reporting obligation to all candidate defaults.
C cl.vocab-prefer EX - DEFINITION ;; Treat 'prefer / avoid' wording as guidance (non-binding). ;; = ;; none ;; Relaxing meta-rule: several oracle DEFAULT/MUST policies are worded with prefer/avoid in the candidate; this vocabulary downgrades them to guidance, which the oracle does not entail.
C cl.vocab-approval OL GOV-017 DEFINITION ;; 'requires approval' denotes a Reserved decision handled by Decision Control. ;; = ;; none ;;
C cl.product-inputs-not-instructions EX GOV-001,GOV-017 MUST_NOT ;; Product inputs (SPECIFICATION.md, CUSTOM_SETTINGS.md, feature specs, task prompts) are not instruction layers and never silently override CLAUDE.md, docs/technology-stack.md or .claude/rules/; a product request for an engineering decision goes through Decision Control. ;; = ;; none ;; Establishes a precedence of engineering instruction layers over product inputs (including task prompts); GOV-001 makes the spec authoritative for product behaviour but says nothing about product inputs being unable to override engineering instructions.
C gov001.spec-authoritative OL GOV-001 MUST ;; When SPECIFICATION.md is non-empty treat it as authoritative for project-specific functional requirements and observable product behaviour. ;; = ;; Empty SPECIFICATION.md in the template is intentional. ;;
C gov003.no-invent OL GOV-003 MUST_NOT ;; Do not silently weaken, contradict or materially extend approved behaviour; do not invent user-visible rules, restrictions, limits, defaults or workflow behaviour because they seem reasonable or are not forbidden. ;; = ;; none ;;
C gov004.ambiguity-approval OL GOV-004 REQUIRES_APPROVAL ;; If an omitted product detail must be decided and materially affects observable behaviour, propose the smallest reasonable option and ask for approval. ;; = ;; none ;;
C gov006.string-semantics OL GOV-006 REQUIRES_APPROVAL ;; When undefined and material, do not silently choose case sensitivity, collation, culture vs ordinal comparison, normalization or trimming; ask for approval. ;; = ;; Only when the approved sources do not define them and the choice materially affects equality, uniqueness, lookup or accepted input. ;;
C gov008.custom-settings-owner OL GOV-008 MUST ;; Record approved project-level tunable limits/defaults in CUSTOM_SETTINGS.md; SPECIFICATION.md owns behavioural intent. ;; = ;; none ;;
C gov009.conflict-stop OL GOV-009 REQUIRES_APPROVAL ;; SPECIFICATION.md and CUSTOM_SETTINGS.md must not contradict; on apparent conflict stop and ask which source to correct. ;; = ;; none ;;
C gov010.no-invent-tunable OL GOV-010 REQUIRES_APPROVAL ;; Do not silently invent a material tunable value; propose with reason, get approval, record in CUSTOM_SETTINGS.md, then synchronize. ;; = ;; Applies only when spec/approved behaviour/CUSTOM_SETTINGS.md do not define it. ;;
C gov021.route-custom-settings OL GOV-021 MUST ;; Synchronize approved CUSTOM_SETTINGS.md value changes through the custom-settings workflow. ;; = ;; none ;;
C gov011.cs-exclusions OL GOV-011 MUST_NOT ;; Never store secrets, environment-specific connection details, package versions, HTTP status codes, ports, migration identifiers or incidental implementation constants in CUSTOM_SETTINGS.md. ;; = ;; none ;;
C gov012.simplicity OL GOV-012 PREFER ;; Prefer simple maintainable solutions; keep complexity proportional to current requirements; avoid speculative abstractions. ;; = ;; none ;;
C gov013.no-speculative OL GOV-013 MUST_NOT ;; Do not introduce frameworks, libraries, infrastructure or architectural patterns without a concrete current need. ;; = ;; none ;;
C gov014.scope OL GOV-014 MUST ;; Keep changes focused on the requested scope and preserve existing behaviour unless the task/approved spec requires change. ;; = ;; Task or approved specification requires change. ;;
C gov018.challenge OL GOV-018,GOV-014 MUST ;; Before implementing a questionable request, identify the concrete concern (duplication, cohesion, triggering/loading, context cost, conflict, complexity) and propose an alternative; never silently rewrite or ignore the user's requirement. ;; = ;; none ;;
C arc001.layers OL ARC-001 MUST ;; Use Clean Architecture with Domain, Application, Infrastructure and Api projects. ;; = ;; none ;;
C arc006.appsvc-default OL ARC-006 DEFAULT ;; Application Services orchestrate use cases. ;; = ;; none ;;
C arc010.controllers-entry OL ARC-010 DEFAULT ;; ASP.NET Core Controllers are the HTTP entry point. ;; = ;; none ;;
C arc013.specific-repos OL ARC-013 DEFAULT ;; Persistence goes through specific repositories. ;; = ;; none ;;
C arc016.uow-boundary OL ARC-016 DEFAULT ;; Persistence goes through IUnitOfWork (commit boundary). ;; = ;; none ;;
C arc019.ef-infra OL ARC-019 MUST ;; EF Core is used inside Infrastructure (implementation of repositories/UoW). ;; = ;; none ;;
C arc003.simple-domain OL ARC-003 DEFAULT ;; Domain entities are simple by default. ;; = ;; none ;;
C dep024.layout OL DEP-024 DEFAULT ;; backend/<Name>.<Layer>/ holds production projects with test projects beside them; frontend/<Name>.Web/ holds the Angular workspace and its tests; docs/ holds documentation; keep separated; no top-level tests/ directory. ;; = ;; none ;;
C dep013.tests-under-backend OL DEP-013 DEFAULT ;; Backend test projects live under backend/ beside the production projects. ;; = ;; none ;;
C arc009.no-cqrs OL ARC-009 REQUIRES_APPROVAL ;; Do not introduce CQRS handlers, MediatR, Kommand, Vertical Slice Architecture or similar mediator-based organization unless explicitly approved. ;; = ;; Explicit approval. ;;
C arc020.not-adopted-reserved OL ARC-020,ARC-004 REQUIRES_APPROVAL ;; Rich Domain Model/DDD tactical patterns, event sourcing, microservices and a project-wide Result/railway model are not adopted; adopting them is Reserved. ;; = ;; Explicit approval. ;;
C dep002.minimal-api-reserved OL DEP-002,ARC-010 REQUIRES_APPROVAL ;; Minimal API endpoints as the HTTP model are not adopted; adoption is Reserved (replaces approved Controllers). ;; = ;; Explicit approval. ;;
C gov017.classify OL GOV-017 MUST ;; Classify a decision as Decided, Delegated or Reserved before acting on it. ;; = ;; none ;;
C gov017.decided OL GOV-017 MUST ;; Decided items (settled by product sources, CLAUDE.md, technology stack, rules, accepted docs/decisions record, or established structure) are followed; reopening requires approval. ;; = ;; none ;;
C gov017.delegated OL GOV-017 ALLOWED ;; Delegated decisions (local, reversible, no boundary/dependency/convention/contract/behaviour change) are decided without asking. ;; = ;; none ;;
C gov005.delegated OL GOV-005 DEFAULT ;; Routine internal implementation details that do not change observable behaviour need no approval. ;; = ;; none ;;
C gov017.reserved OL GOV-017,ARC-020 REQUIRES_APPROVAL ;; Reserved decisions require explicit approval, including changing an accepted project or architecture decision. ;; = ;; Unless already required by the specification or established project structure. ;;
C arc020.reserved-style OL ARC-020,ARC-004,ARC-009 REQUIRES_APPROVAL ;; A new architectural style/pattern (Rich Domain/DDD tactical, CQRS/MediatR/VSA, event sourcing, microservices) is Reserved. ;; = ;; Unless already required by spec/established structure. ;;
C arc020.reserved-project OL ARC-020 REQUIRES_APPROVAL ;; A new production project, layer or assembly, or an additional DbContext/persistence boundary, is Reserved. ;; = ;; Unless already required by spec/established structure. ;;
C x.cl-reserved-refgraph EX ARC-020,ARC-001 REQUIRES_APPROVAL ;; Any changed project reference graph is Reserved (requires approval). ;; = ;; Unless already required by spec/established structure. ;; ARC-020 gates new layers/projects; the oracle does not require approval for changing references between existing projects (ARC-001 only constrains direction).
C arc020.reserved-persistence OL ARC-020,DEP-002 REQUIRES_APPROVAL ;; Changed persistence boundaries or persistence technology are Reserved. ;; = ;; Unless already required. ;;
C arc020.reserved-infra OL ARC-020 REQUIRES_APPROVAL ;; New infrastructure category (messaging, background processing, distributed caching) is Reserved. ;; = ;; Unless already required. ;;
C x.cl-reserved-infra-extra EX ARC-020 REQUIRES_APPROVAL ;; Introducing search, external storage or external identity infrastructure is Reserved. ;; = ;; Unless already required. ;; ARC-020's enumerated categories are messaging/background/distributed caching/auth architecture; search and external storage (and identity as an infrastructure category) are additional approval gates.
C arc020.reserved-replace OL ARC-020,DEP-002 REQUIRES_APPROVAL ;; Replacing an approved baseline technology is Reserved. ;; = ;; Unless already required. ;;
C x.cl-reserved-major-lib EX DEP-001,GOV-013 REQUIRES_APPROVAL ;; Adding any major library or framework is Reserved (requires approval). ;; = ;; Unless already required. ;; Oracle requires a concrete need (DEP-001/GOV-013) and approval only for replacement or risky licenses; approval for every major library addition is an added gate.
C arc020.reserved-result OL ARC-020 REQUIRES_APPROVAL ;; A project-wide Result model is Reserved. ;; = ;; Unless already required. ;;
C x.cl-reserved-convention EX ARC-020 REQUIRES_APPROVAL ;; Any project-wide convention or abstraction other code must follow is Reserved. ;; = ;; Unless already required. ;; Generalises ARC-020's 'project-wide Result' example to every project-wide convention/abstraction.
C arc020.reserved-auth OL ARC-020 REQUIRES_APPROVAL ;; A new or changed authentication/authorization architecture is Reserved. ;; = ;; Unless already required. ;;
C api014.breaking-approval OL API-014 REQUIRES_APPROVAL ;; A breaking public API change is Reserved (requires approval). ;; = ;; Unless already required. ;;
C x.cl-reserved-versioning EX API-013,DEP-017 REQUIRES_APPROVAL ;; Adopting API versioning is Reserved (requires explicit approval). ;; = ;; Unless already required. ;; API-013 permits versioning when a concrete compatibility need exists without an approval gate; the candidate adds explicit approval for adoption.
C gov004.reserved-product OL GOV-004,GOV-010 REQUIRES_APPROVAL ;; Product behaviour or tunable values not defined by product sources are Reserved. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.cl-unclear-heuristic EX GOV-017 MUST ;; In an unclear case classify as Reserved if any answer is yes: adds/removes/replaces a dependency, framework or infrastructure capability; changes a project/layer/reference boundary; establishes a convention other code follows; changes observable behaviour or a public contract; would be expensive to reverse. ;; = ;; Only for cases not otherwise clear. ;; GOV-017 names the classes but no classification test; this heuristic widens Reserved (e.g. adding or removing any dependency, any expensive-to-reverse choice) beyond the oracle's approval gates.
C gov017.stop-decision-request OL GOV-017 MUST ;; For a Reserved decision stop that part of the work, issue a Decision Request through architecture-decision, and continue only with compliant non-Reserved work. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.cl-user-instruction-approval EX GOV-017,GOV-007 MUST ;; An explicit user instruction counts as approval and must be recorded through the architecture-decision workflow. ;; = ;; none ;; Defines what constitutes approval and adds a recording obligation for every approved Reserved decision; not entailed by GOV-017 (GOV-007 only covers approved behavioural rules).
C gov017.headless OL GOV-017 MUST_NOT ;; In an autonomous/headless run never make a Reserved decision; proceed only on a compliant non-Reserved path and report every unresolved Decision Request. ;; autonomous or headless runs ;; none ;;
C gov015.git-explicit OL GOV-015 MUST_NOT ;; Do not commit, push, merge, rebase, reset, force-push, delete branches or perform other repository-changing Git operations unless explicitly requested. ;; = ;; Explicit request. ;;
C gov016.parallel OL GOV-016 MUST ;; Parallel implementation work uses separate branches or worktrees; keep unrelated changes out of the current branch. ;; = ;; none ;;
C wf001.route-workflow OL WF-001 MUST ;; Run the workflow skill that matches the situation (routing table: development-workflow, verify, code-review, build-fix, add-dependency, custom-settings, project-structure, architecture-decision, security-scan, git-workflow). ;; = ;; none ;;

C dep002.use-approved OL DEP-002 MUST_NOT ;; When the stack defines a technology for a capability use it rather than silently selecting an alternative; replacing it is Reserved. ;; = ;; Approved replacement. ;;
C dep003.resolve-at-install OL DEP-003 MUST ;; Resolve package versions at install time through add-dependency; never copy versions from memory or examples. ;; = ;; none ;;
C dep008.platform OL DEP-008 DECIDED ;; Platform is .NET 10 LTS, C# 14, ASP.NET Core and ASP.NET Core Controllers; moving to preview/RC requires approval. ;; = ;; Approval for preview/RC. ;;
C x.ts-servicing EX DEP-008 MUST ;; Use .NET 10 on its latest stable servicing release. ;; = ;; none ;; DEP-008 fixes the major platform (.NET 10 LTS) only; requiring the latest stable servicing (patch) release is an additional version constraint.
C dep009.persistence OL DEP-009 DECIDED ;; Persistence is EF Core with Microsoft SQL Server (Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore.SqlServer); provider concerns stay out of Application and Domain. ;; = ;; none ;;
C dep010.fluentvalidation OL DEP-010 DECIDED ;; FluentValidation (FluentValidation, FluentValidation.DependencyInjectionExtensions) is the standard explicit request/use-case validation library. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.ts-no-legacy-autovalidation EX DEP-010 MUST_NOT ;; Do not use a deprecated or legacy ASP.NET automatic-validation integration package. ;; = ;; Concrete requirement. ;; Oracle names FluentValidation as standard but does not prohibit its automatic ASP.NET validation integration packages.
C dep010.logging OL DEP-010 DECIDED ;; Application code logs through ILogger<T>; Serilog (Serilog.AspNetCore) is the logging provider. ;; = ;; none ;;
C dep001.sinks-only-when-required OL DEP-001 MUST ;; Add Serilog sinks only when required; a Console sink suffices for local Development. ;; = ;; none ;;
C dep012.swagger OL DEP-012 DECIDED ;; Swagger UI via Swashbuckle.AspNetCore is the default interactive API documentation/manual testing surface in Development (/swagger); built-in AddOpenApi/MapOpenApi is not the default. ;; = ;; none ;;
C api017.swagger-dev OL API-017,DEP-012 DEFAULT ;; Expose Swagger UI outside Development only when requirements justify it. ;; = ;; Requirements justify. ;;
C dep013.stack OL DEP-013 DECIDED ;; Testing uses NUnit; Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc.Testing with WebApplicationFactory<Program> is the integration-test baseline; backend test projects live under backend/ beside production projects. ;; = ;; none ;;
C dep022.slnx OL DEP-022 DEFAULT ;; Use .slnx by default; legacy .sln only when an external tool or project requirement needs it. ;; = ;; External tool/project requirement. ;;
C dep023.shared-build OL DEP-023 DEFAULT ;; Repository-level Directory.Build.props for genuinely shared build settings and Directory.Packages.props for CPM; project-specific settings stay in their projects. ;; = ;; none ;;
C dep014.angular OL DEP-014 DECIDED ;; Angular latest stable supported by the selected Node.js, created with current Angular CLI (compatible TypeScript/RxJS), standalone APIs, strict mode, routing, zoneless when supported, SCSS, Angular Material/CDK, Vitest. ;; = ;; Zoneless only when supported. ;;
C dep015.no-overlap-libs OL DEP-015 MUST_NOT ;; Do not add NgRx, Axios, Lodash, Bootstrap, Tailwind or extra form/component/state libraries by default; use built-in Angular first and add extras only for a concrete need. ;; = ;; Concrete need. ;;
C dep001.conditional-only-when-needed OL DEP-001,DEP-011 MUST ;; Conditional technologies are approved but added only when the capability is actually needed. ;; = ;; none ;;
C dep011.mapping OL DEP-011 DEFAULT ;; Manual mapping is fine for simple cases; Mapster (Mapster, Mapster.DependencyInjection) is approved when mapping volume warrants it. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.ts-no-other-mapper-domain EX DEP-011,DEP-002,ARC-002 MUST_NOT ;; No other mapping framework without approval; mapping-library concerns stay out of Domain. ;; = ;; Approval. ;; DEP-011 approves Mapster conditionally but does not forbid other mappers or exclude mapping-library concerns from Domain (ARC-002 lists EF/ASP.NET/HTTP/persistence/external-service concerns only).
C dep011.resilience OL DEP-011 DEFAULT ;; Microsoft resilience packages (Microsoft.Extensions.Http.Resilience, Microsoft.Extensions.Resilience) are approved only when a real integration needs resilience. ;; = ;; none ;;
C dep013.testcontainers OL DEP-013,TST-007 DEFAULT ;; Testcontainers is conditional: when isolated real-provider tests justify it. ;; = ;; none ;;
C dep016.playwright OL DEP-016 DEFAULT ;; Playwright is the approved default when frontend E2E coverage is required; not in the minimal scaffold. ;; = ;; none ;;
C dep018.docker OL DEP-018 MUST_NOT ;; Do not introduce Docker merely because the app can be containerized; add container artifacts only when the project or deployment needs them. ;; = ;; none ;;

@@ output/template/SPECIFICATION.md ;; Empty product specification placeholder (0 bytes); no lines to partition.
